The overall flow feels calm, and I like getting a quick chance to check the details before saving. Editing the title and adding `reading` felt natural.

I’d keep this approach, with a few changes:

- Please also collect and show the site’s small icon, and collect its preview image where available.
- When I start typing labels, suggest labels I’ve used before so I stay consistent.
- The title or card should open the original page when selected.
- If I paste a link I already saved, don’t create another copy—take me to the existing bookmark so I can update it.
- It would be useful to mark something as “read later” while saving it.

The amount of information in the list is mostly right. The title, description, labels, and icon should be easiest to scan; the full address and my note can be a little less prominent so the list doesn’t become visually heavy.
